subject: Request: Qtrly invoice cadence + extended payment term for TidalHealth
summary: Sales requests quarter-based invoicing with Net-90 for a large healthcare pilot; finance requires exec sign-off. Leadership approves modified terms (Net-60 + quarterly invoicing for pilot year) with conditions.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@tidalhealth.com>, Daniel Morgan <dmorgan@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: quarterly invoicing + payment term ask for TidalHealth pilot

Hi Susan / Daniel,

Thanks again for the time today — excited about the pilot plan and the integrations touchpoints you outlined. Per our conversation, TidalHealth has requested two non-standard billing items to be included in the commercial terms before procurement can circulate a PO: 

- Consolidated quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter covering all seats and usage)
- Payment term: Net-90 from invoice date for the pilot year

Attached are the latest MSA redlines (Tidal_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and a suggested billing matrix (tidal-quarterly-billing-mop.xlsx) that maps milestones to invoice quarters. We are proposing a 15% platform discount in exchange for a 12-month committed pilot (minimum 500 seats).

Can you confirm timeline for PO issuance if we accept these two items? Also looping Vanessa for commercial alignment.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Tidal_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf]
[Attachment: tidal-quarterly-billing-mop.xlsx]
From: Susan Park <susan.park@tidalhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Daniel Morgan <dmorgan@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@tidalhealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: quarterly invoicing + payment term ask for TidalHealth pilot

Jonas — thanks for the docs. Procurement confirmed they will process once terms are final, but two clarifications before I can sign off internally: 

1) We need assurance that quarterly invoices will include line-item usage detail (tokens & seats) per Redwood’s format (we attached a sample).
2) Net-90 is a stretch for our AP policy; will Redwood accept a PO that references quarterly invoices but pays on Net-60 if we negotiate with our treasury team? If Redwood insists on Net-90, procurement will need an executive exception approved prior to PO.

If you could route this to whoever handles exec approvals, we can escalate on our side.

—Susan
Susan Park
Director, Strategic Procurement
TidalHealth
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: TidalHealth procurement — exec approval request for invoicing cadence / payment term

Marissa / Vanessa / Ben — forwarding the thread and attachments. Key points:

- Large pilot: 12 months, ~500 seats, projected ARR if converted ~ $1.2M
- Customer requests: quarterly invoicing (one invoice/quarter) AND Net-90 payment term for pilot year
- We proposed: 15% discount for committed pilot

Finance flagged Net-90 as outside standard terms and requested executive sign-off. They also want a credit-style mitigation (e.g., milestone holdback or shorter payment term).

Recommended approval path: accept quarterly invoicing as requested; counter Net-90 with Net-60 (finance-friendly), and add a clause: quarterly invoices payable Net-60 + a 30% of initial onboarding fee due on signing (immediate), and a quarterly usage report included with each invoice. Also propose a 6-month review clause to reassess payment terms after the pilot is underway.

Asking for a quick decision — procurement is waiting and they may delay the PO if we don't provide an answer by Tue. Deal is time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: TidalHealth procurement — exec approval request for invoicing cadence / payment term

Jonas / team — after reviewing the numbers and risk mitigations, I approve the commercial concession with the following mandatory conditions: 

1) Final approved terms: Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per calendar quarter) + Net-60 payment term for the pilot year only. We will not accept Net-90.
2) Upfronts: 30% of the quoted onboarding fee due at signing (to be captured in the SOW).
3) Reporting: Each quarterly invoice must include the token/seat usage export in Redwood’s billing schema (attach to invoice).
4) Credit mitigation: We add a clause to hold revenue recognition for any invoices unpaid after 90 days; continued service at Redwood’s discretion.
5) Pilot review: 6-month commercial review checkpoint with option to revert to standard monthly invoicing if late payments occur.

Document the approval in HubSpot (DEAL-4821) and attach the signed exception. Finance to confirm operational implementation details (AR flow, invoice memo). Ben — please coordinate with Revenue Ops and create the PO acceptance instructions for TidalHealth accounting. Vanessa — please communicate approved terms to the customer and get an updated PO.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
[Approval recorded: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-4821]
